H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H6666: rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H1777: a straight course, i.e. sail direct
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H6664: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity
H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H7965: safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace
H8199: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
H3467: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor
H1792: to crumble; transitively, to bruise (literally or figuratively)
H6231: to press upon, i.e. oppress, defraud, violate, overflow
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H8121: the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
H3381: to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H1488: a fleece (as shorn); also mown grass
H7241: a rain (as an accumulation of drops)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H6524: to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom; generally, to spread; specifically, to fly (as extending the wings); figuratively, to flourish
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H1097: properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.
H7287: to tread down, i.e. subjugate; specifically, to crumble off
H3220: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
H5104: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity
H657: cessation, i.e. an end (especially of the earth); often used adverb, no further; also the ankle (in the dual), as being the extremity of the leg or foot
H3766: to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate
H6728: a desert-dweller, i.e. nomad or wild beast
H6083: dust (as powdered or gray); hence, clay, earth, mud
H8659: Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the ephithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite
H339: properly, a habitable spot (as desirable); dry land, a coast, an island
H4503: a donation; euphemistically, tribute; specifically a sacrificial offering (usually bloodless and voluntary)
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H7614: Sheba, the name of three early progenitors of tribes and of an Ethiopian district
H5434: Seba, a son of Cush, and the country settled by him
H7126: to approach (causatively, bring near) for whatever purpose
H7812: to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H5647: to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve, till, (causatively) enslave, etc.
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H5337: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
H7768: properly, to be free; but used only causatively and reflexively, to halloo (for help, i.e. freedom from some trouble)
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H5826: to surround, i.e. protect or aid
H2347: properly, to cover, i.e. (figuratively) to compassionate
H1800: properly, dangling, i.e. (by implication) weak or thin
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H2555: violence; by implication, wrong; by meton. unjust gain
H1350: to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property, marry his widow, etc.)
H3365: properly, apparently, to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) valuable; causatively, to make rare (figuratively, to inhibit)
H1818: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood)
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H2421: to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive
H2091: gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky
H6419: to judge (officially or mentally); by extension, to intercede, pray
H1157: in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.
H8548: properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H1250: grain of any kind (even while standing in the field); by extension the open country
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H7493: to undulate (as the earth, the sky, etc.; also a field of grain), particularly through fear; specifically, to spring (as a locust)
H3844: Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine
H6692: to twinkle, i.e. glance; by analogy, to blossom (figuratively, flourish)
H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H5125: to resprout, i.e. propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual
H833: to be straight (used in the widest sense, especially to be level, right, happy); figuratively, to go forward, be honest, proper
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H6381: properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful
H905: properly, separation; by implication, a part of the body, branch of atree, bar forcarrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apart, only, besides
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H4390: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H3615: to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume)
H8605: intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
